Digital cell

Classic 2D fallback

What if… (metabolic model)

Precomputed with flux balance analysis (FBA), which calculates balanced, steady reaction flows through the WormJam whole-animal metabolic network: model calculation, not yet benchmarked.

Aging observations

Reviewed published observations at the adult days each study sampled. Retrospective and illustrative: not a predictive aging model, and it does not drive the signal cascade or the metabolic model.

Narrated tours (signal cascade)

English voice with subtitles; every step can also be read and stepped through without sound. The signal spread is calculated in advance by the model's cascade engine: it shows up or down and relative strength, not amounts, rates or timing.

Signalling pathways

Make it move

Click a gene in the cell, then activate or knock it down. The signal travels along the model's influence arrows step by step.
Animation shows the direction of influence along the model's arrows, including arrows that still need references (qualitative signal flow). It is not a kinetic (chemical-rate) simulation: no concentrations, rates or timings are modelled.

View

Illustration, not simulation. Vesicles bud from the ER and travel to the Golgi (COPII-coated vesicles; generic overview source: Reactome R-CEL-203973, computationally inferred from human, not worm or adult-intestinal evidence). From the trans-Golgi, green vesicles go to the plasma membrane and purple ones towards lysosomes, and an autophagosome fuses with a lysosome to form an autolysosome (textbook overview; source [REF NEEDED]). Paths, vesicle numbers and timing are arbitrary display choices, not measured speeds or rates. The plasma-membrane arrival points do not show apical or basolateral sorting: the model has no sourced sorting data.
Gut granules (blue-teal), the apical junction (CeAJ, green band) on a faint neighbouring-cell boundary, and the terminal web (yellow) above the endotube (pink), a layer rich in intermediate filaments (IF), under the brush border. Sourced atlas records, drawn schematically: number, size, colour and position are display choices. Not simulated. Click one for its sources and cautions.

Graphics

Both looks show the same model, data and controls; colours and shading are teaching conventions, not measurements. Auto picks Light, Balanced or High from how smoothly this device draws the scene (measured time between frames, not graphics-card timings). Choices are saved in this browser only.
